units: <cite ref="Berakhot 39a:10">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>יתיב אבי ת׳ וכ׳</he> it is placed on the stove and boils (v. <cite ref="V00195"><he>תּוֹךְ</he> I</cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>דדיירי אבי ת׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אדפי</he>) they nest over the fire-place.

senses.gloss: hollow on the hearth where coals are put, cooking stove (v. Sm. Ant.3 Engl. ed., s. v. Focus).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 102:4">Targ. Ps. CII, 4</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M00581"><he>מוקד</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1:2">Y. Sabb. III, beg., 5ᶜ</cite> <he>גריף תי׳ וכ׳</he> the fire-place is cleared, and the dish put in; <he>גרוף ת׳ ויהב תלתא וכ׳</he> (not <he>גריף</he>) clear the fire-place, and put three stones in.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:3:5">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> <he>הוה … גו ת׳ וזרק קומי ת׳</he> seemed to throw the kernels into the fire-place, but he threw them before the fire-place.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>צפה … על ת׳</he> saw a pot over the fire-place; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite> <cite ref="I00647"><he>טַפְיָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="V00818"><he>תַּפְיָין</he></cite>.
